title: Firefox browsing history
whyItMatters: Lists every page visited with timestamps and visit counts, plus bookmarks and tags. It shows interests, habits and often which services the person uses.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data (places.sqlite): https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: One places.sqlite per profile, with places.sqlite-wal and -shm alongside while Firefox is open.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Firefox, open Library > Import and Backup and export bookmarks to an HTML file if you want to keep them.
steps: In Firefox, open History > Clear Recent History and clear everything.
Delete the places file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local history and bookmarks for every Firefox profile on this PC; synced history can return while the account stays signed in.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, Delete browsing, search and download history on Firefox: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/delete-browsing-search-download-history-firefox
